summary: Iteration 6 (withdrawal rules + trading board). Backend: new /app/backend/tests/test_termv_iter6.py = 15/15 PASS covering withdraw ADD success + quota-freeing, swap withdraw => 403, window-closed withdraw => 403, trading board GET/POST/DELETE, upsert semantics, drop-must-be-owned + add-must-not-be-owned + empty payload validation, delete-other's forbidden, admin toggle disables board + blocks POST, window-closed hides board, admin view + remove, and student blocked from all /api/admin/trading*. Frontend: verified via preview URL - Student /trading sidebar link present, drop-chip-<CODE> (7 chips) + add-chip-<CODE> (32 chips) render, save-case-button posts (toast 'Your case is live on the trading board'), own card renders with (You) marker + PGPID PGP41071 + Wants to drop/add chips, delete-case-button appears after save. Student RequestDetail: [data-testid=withdraw-request-button] visible on ADD (status Submitted, window open), clicking withdraws and transitions to CANCELLED; on COURSE_SWAP detail the button is absent and the note 'Swap requests cannot be withdrawn once submitted.' is shown. Admin /admin/trading: sidebar 'Trading Board' present, trading-enabled-switch toggles enabled state (verified via GET /admin/trading), window status line shows OPEN, remove-post-<PGPID> deletes the post. Privacy: trading responses only expose pgpid/student_name/course_id/course_code/course_name/credits — no section capacity/strength. State restored: window OPEN + trading enabled + all TEST_* docs and PGP41071 requests/trading_posts purged.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cancel_request (lines 652-667) is clean: correct order — ownership -> type gate -> window gate -> status gate -> add_history. All four error paths return the exact strings the frontend keys off.
trading_is_open() correctly combines admin toggle AND window state, and get_trading_settings seeds a default {enabled:true} row idempotently.
upsert_trading_post enforces (a) drop_course_ids ⊆ owned, (b) add_course_ids ∩ owned = ∅ AND ids exist in cmap, (c) at least one non-empty list — matches spec exactly.
delete_trading_post correctly returns 403 (not 404) for other-owner AND non-existent post ids — good, doesn't leak existence.
admin_delete_trading silently succeeds even if post_id doesn't exist (delete_many-style). Minor: consider returning 404 for missing ids for consistency with student delete errors, but not blocking.

TradingBoard.js has a small race: three parallel GETs on mount (/trading/board, /trading/mine, /student/dashboard, /student/available-courses). Works but consider Promise.all + single setState to avoid flicker on slow networks.
server.py is now 1317 lines — recurring modularisation recommendation from iter 4/5 still stands (split into routers: student, admin, trading, swaps).

RequestDetail withdraw-not-allowed message covers three branches (swap / bad-status / window-closed) — good coverage; consider surfacing the same when window is closed but status still SUBMITTED for extra clarity (current message already does this).
seed_data_creation: Tests self-cleanup via mongosh delete_many on requests/trading_posts for PGP41071/PGP41473 before + after each test class. Verified 0 residual docs after run.
